<!-- vrization:english -->
## English

### Use case

Describe the user's task, current limitation and a concrete example. Include relevant target platforms, viewers or integration engines.

### Suggested behavior

Explain the result you want and any alternatives you considered. If proposing an external library or asset, link its exact upstream source and license. Keep remote input explicitly authorized by the PC user.

### Validation

Describe how someone could check the improvement and which hardware would be needed. Public project documentation for the feature must keep full English first and Chinese below on the same page.

---

<!-- vrization:chinese -->
## 简体中文

### 使用场景

说明用户想完成的事、当前限制与具体例子，并注明相关平台、手机盒子或集成引擎。

### 建议行为

说明期望结果与考虑过的替代方案。建议外部库或素材时，附精确上游来源与许可链接。远程输入仍须由电脑用户主动授权。

### 验证方法

说明如何检查改进，以及需要哪些硬件。功能对应的公共文档须在同一页完整英文在上、完整中文在下。
